stele.talisman_jackiechan.lo_pei.front: 維林景和元秊冬十一月聖鬥士洛公薨天子震悼輟朝三日追封靖火侯食邑三千戶贈使持節靖火將軍賜諡忠武勅有司建祠于其故里春秋致祭立碑紀功以垂萬世公諱佩林之世臣也少通祕術當火妖聖主出世肆虐天下焚城邑屠生靈莫能禦者公以一身當之設壇布咒封聖主于石像之內碎其十二符咒散藏四海絕域使永無復聚之患天下旣定公不言功退居林下及卒國人罷市巷哭如喪考妣
stele.talisman_jackiechan.lo_pei.front.m: 火妖燎原公提三尺之咒以定之符石散天公垂萬世之祜以寧之公身雖歿公靈在天祠宇巍巍俎豆秊秊凡百有位視此刻焉
stele.talisman_jackiechan.lo_pei.front.s: 景和元秊冬月勅建禮部侍郎歐陽恪奉勅撰翰林院編修陳有義奉勅書丹嗣靖火侯洛亮立石
stele.talisman_jackiechan.lo_pei.back:
聖旨
洛佩克定火妖之亂功在社稷朕甚嘉之今旣薨逝宜隆褒恤特追封靖火侯食邑三千戶贈使持節靖火將軍賜諡忠武敕建專祠春秋二祭著為令典欽此
stele.talisman_jackiechan.lo_pei.front.t:
In the eleventh month of winter, in the first year of Jinghe of Lin, the Sacred Warrior Lord Lo passed away. The Emperor was struck with grief and suspended court for three days. He posthumously enfeoffed him as Marquis of Quelling Fire with a fief of three thousand households, and conferred upon him the titles of Bearer of the Staff and General of Quelling Fire. He bestowed upon him the posthumous name Zhongwu(Meaning Loyal and Martial), and commanded the officials to erect a shrine in his native place, where sacrifices would be offered each spring and autumn. This stele is erected to record his merits, that they may be handed down through ten thousand generations.

The Lord's personal name was Pei. He was a hereditary minister of Lin. In his youth he mastered the secret arts. When the Fire Demon Shendu arose and brought ruin upon the world, burning cities and slaughtering the people, none could resist him. The Lord alone stood against him. He established an altar and wove his spells, sealed Shendu within a stone statue, split his twelve talismans, and scattered them to the four corners of the world, so that they might never be gathered again. When the realm was at peace, the Lord did not speak of his merits, but retired to the woods. At his death, the people closed their markets and wept in the streets, as though mourning their own parents.
stele.talisman_jackiechan.lo_pei.front.s:
Erected by imperial command in the winter month of the first year of Jinghe.
Respectfully composed by Ouyang Ke, Vice Minister of Rites, by imperial command.
Respectfully inscribed by Chen Youyi, Compiler of the Hanlin Academy, by imperial command.
Stele erected by Lo Liang, heir to the Marquis of Quelling Fire.
stele.talisman_jackiechan.lo_pei.back.tr: By Imperial Edict: Lo Pei quelled the rebellion of the Fire Demon, and his merits are to the credit of the realm. We greatly commend him. Now that he has passed away, he ought to be honored with generous posthumous favor. He is hereby specially enfeoffed as Marquis of Quelling Fire with a fief of three thousand households, and granted the titles of Bearer of the Staff and General of Quelling Fire. He is bestowed the posthumous name Zhongwu. A dedicated shrine shall be built by imperial command, with sacrifices offered each spring and autumn, and this shall be established as a permanent statute. Respect this.
